WITH totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total
  FROM scanfeatures
), unit_shares AS (
  SELECT
    sf.zoneref,
    sf.articount,
    sf.articount::numeric / NULLIF(t.artifact_total, 0) AS share
  FROM scanfeatures AS sf
  CROSS JOIN totals AS t
  WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM unit_shares
)
SELECT
  us.zoneref AS site_code,
  us.articount AS artifact_count,
  us.share,
  us.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average
FROM unit_shares AS us
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
